points.form: を前提に / を前提として
points.formation: N + frame; plain clause + こと + frame; noun modifier を前提とした/する + N.
points.teachingChoice: A premise may be met or still conditional. Do not infer completed order/proof confirmation from stating the assumption.

points.form: ても差し支えない / ありませんか
points.formation: Verb te/ i くて + も; N/na でも; negative acceptability predicate, with か for an explicit question.
points.teachingChoice: Own-side sending permission differs from a recipient-action request. Bare 差し支える is not inherently honorific; appropriate authority/context matters.

points.form: ていただければ幸いです / ご確認いただければ幸いです
points.formation: Recipient action Vte + conditional potential いただければ + 幸いです; receiving noun Nをいただければ; suru-action ごNいただければ frame.
points.teachingChoice: MLC supplies exact conditional 幸い request formation; JapanesePod101 conditional-receiving request section and Culture Agency actor/recipient-decision guidance corroborate use. Requested confirmation is not an already-received answer.

points.form: ということでよろしいでしょうか
points.formation: Restated quoted content + ということで + confirmation question. Neutral polite ということでいいですか; casual ってことでいい？.
points.teachingChoice: Specific terms and actor decision stay visible. An explicit reply, not the question itself, confirms this order.

sourceCautions: Practical keigo retrieves earlier forms; no assertion that all four frames are newly or officially N1.
Do not adopt universal absence-of-politeness bans, all-premises-unfulfilled claims or more-keigo-always-better rules.
JapanesePod101 casual-language popularity cautions outside the relevant confirmation section are not imported.
